final_claim: For the explicit Sturmfels--Telen real cubic surface with its published Table-2 cyclic line-intersection order, the 270 chamber walls split as 30 triangle--pentagon, 120 quadrilateral--pentagon, and 120 quadrilateral--quadrilateral; every pentagon has one triangular and four quadrilateral neighbors, and the 90 quadrilaterals split into 20 Q^4, 20 Q^3P, and 50 Q^2P^2 neighbor profiles.
limitations: Specific to the explicit Table-2 cyclic-order chamber complex; no moduli-wide constancy is claimed.
This is chamber-incidence data, not a new statement about canonical-form linear relations.
